issues.surface: Social posts › Weekly post › Time column (legacy rows and "All on one line"; also "Big picture")
issues.detail: The 12-hour range "11:30am – 10:45pm" is 318.1px wide at the design's 44px, in a 250px Time box, so fitLines shrinks it. "11:30 – 22:45" is 223.3px and fits at full size. No truncation, no dropped line, never at the floor. The US time is the smallest text on its row; in wide families it is smaller than the place name. Rows also differ: "8pm – 12:30am" draws at 43px next to "11:30am – 10:45pm" at 34px (GB: 44/44px).
issues.measured: Default Oswald, single-event row (Thu 1 Oct): GB 44px → US 34px (−23%), asked 44px, floor 15px. Big picture: 44→35px. Worst family, Montserrat: 43→27px (−37%; the place name on that row is 30px). 19/21 bundled families shrink ≥15%. Two-event rows are height-bound, so mostly equal in Oswald; worst Archivo Black 34→23px.
issues.frequency: Every US weekly post with a non-:00 time (e.g. 11:30am). The 12h clock is the poster default in both countries, so a GB truck on 12h sees the same thing (GB 12h, Oswald: 34px). Only GB trucks that chose 24h avoid it.
issues.fix: Widen the default Time share for 12h designs (weights 26 → about 32), or drop the spaces around the dash for 12h ("11:30am–10:45pm"), or default the Time box to "Use two lines" for 12h so start and end stack.

issues.surface: Social posts › Weekly post › Time column (every arrangement)
issues.detail: On a story canvas the rows are taller but the Time box keeps the same width (247px), so the US range stays capped by width. It barely grows from portrait (34px) while the date (52px) and place (41px) on the same row grow. It is the biggest GB/US gap on the poster. No truncation, never at the floor (22px).
issues.measured: Oswald, single-event row: rows/one line GB 48 → US 34px (−29%); big picture 49→34px (−31%); day on top 62→51px (−18%). Raleway, one line: 44→28px (−36%). Montserrat, day on top: 62→41px. Families shrinking ≥15%: one line 21/21, day on top 18/21.
issues.frequency: Every US weekly post made on a 9:16 (story) blank with a non-:00 time.
issues.fix: Same as D-20. A wider Time share or a two-line 12h time matters most here, because the row has spare height.

issues.surface: Social posts › Weekly post › Time column (legacy rows and "All on one line")
issues.detail: With the default Oswald the square post is fine (35→34px). Square rows are short enough that height, not width, sets the size. With wider bundled families the 12h range becomes width-bound and shrinks well below GB and below the place name. No truncation; never at the floor (12px). "Day on top" and "Big picture" give Time a wider cell and are unaffected (0/21 families ≥15%).
issues.measured: Archivo Black: GB 35 → US 23px (−34%; place on the same row 27px). Merriweather and Work Sans: 35→26px. Inter, Montserrat and Poppins: 35→27–28px. 12/21 families shrink ≥15% (one line).
issues.frequency: US weekly posts on a square blank whose design uses a wide font (12 of the 21 bundled families).

method: Fixtures: Pizza Kitchen (test-truck), GB (GBP, en-GB, Europe/London, 24h, VAT incl., no tip/fee per seed) vs US (USD, en-US, America/New_York, 12h, sales tax 8.875% excl., 20% tip, service fee 3%+$0.30, card fee 3%), at Wed 30 Sep 2026 11:50 local (kit.setNow/setDeviceTz). Order #A123 (longest realistic: per-event counter or offline provisional), pickup 12:45/12:45 PM (plus 00:30 and ASAP), 6 items with a 6-modifier list, item notes, long order note, 4-digit totals. TICKETS: the real Order→mapOrderToTicket→renderTicket and renderTestTicket at 58/80 mm (scripts/us-layout-audit/D-print/tickets.cjs); the ESC/POS bytes were decoded back into printed rows and each row's physical columns (×2 for double width) compared with 32/48. EMAILS: the real lib/email.ts builders (formatConfirmationEmail x6 variants, formatNewOrderEmail; sendRefund/Cancellation/EventCancellationEmail with fetch replaced in-process by a recorder — nothing sent) plus the inbound-schedule markup transcribed, painted in WebKit at 375 and 600 px with network blocked; line counts via Range.getClientRects clustered by line, GB/US elements matched by normalised text then DOM path; horizontal overflow and page height (emails.cjs). PLANS PDF: real buildPlansPdfHtml(GB / US with fixture prices) painted at A4 794 px vs Letter 816 px, header row measured (plans-pdf.cjs). Sheets by sheets.cjs (sharp). SOCIAL POSTS: Rendered through the real renderer with no browser, DB, network, build or dev server. The tool compiles lib/weekly-post (render.ts → draw.ts → fit.ts, satori/resvg via next/og) with scripts/_slot-interval-compile.cjs, as scripts/_weekly-post-examples.cjs does, and wraps fit.ts `fitLines` to record each text box's asked size, height ceiling, floor (max(ABSOLUTE_MIN_FONT 8, round(asked × MIN_FONT_FRACTION 0.35))), fitted size, truncation and dropped lines. Box rectangles come from the element tree. Fixture: Pizza Kitchen (test-truck / test-kitchen) on a synthetic gradient blank. GB: Europe/London, Monday weeks, 24h, en-GB words. US: America/New_York, Sunday weeks, 12h, en-US words. Moment: Wednesday 30 September 2026 11:50 local, passed to weekRange as the clock (GB 10:50Z, US 15:50Z). Events are keyed by date over 27 Sep–4 Oct, so each poster shows its own 7 days and a date carries the same events in both countries. Every day trades, four days have two events, with 11:30–22:45, 20:00–00:30 and names up to "Great Waldingfield Recreation Ground". Templates use the default design at 1080×1080, 1080×1350 and 1080×1920: the weekly post as an unopened legacy-rows design, as converted on open (daysFromLegacy, "All on one line"), and as the "Day on top" and "Big picture" quick layouts; the single-event post (defaultEventLayout) with the long range and the midnight range. PNGs use the default Oswald, plus Montserrat (portrait) and Archivo Black (square) pairs as the worst families. A measurement-only sweep covers all 21 bundled families × 3 sizes × 3 weekly arrangements + the event post, plus all four date styles with "Day on its own line" on/off and GB on its default 12h clock. PNGs are downscaled to 540px wide (50%) with a palette. Scripts: scripts/us-layout-audit/D-print/social/render-social.cjs, make-sheet-and-findings.cjs.
